Information for Tenderer/Consultant :
Eligibility of Tenderer : (1) The minimum number of years of general experience of the Tenderer in the construction works as Prime Contractor or
Subcontractor or Management Contractor shall be 10 years. [Years counting backward from the date of publication of IFT in the
news paper], (2) The minimum specific experience as a Prime Contractor or Subcontractor or Management Contractor in
construction works of at least 01 (one) contract(s) of similar nature,complexity and methods/ construction technology successfully
completed within the last 10 (ten) years, each with a value of at least Tk. 300.00 Crore. Similar nature,complexity and methods/
construction technology means Construction of 4-lane Contineous Flyover along with 2 Nos. Ramp/Loop, a total length of
minimum 3.0Km in city area successfully completed in a single contract. [Years counting backward from the date of publication of
IFT in thenewspaper], (3) The required average annual construction turn over shall be greater than Tk. 420 Crore over the last 05
(five) years. [Years counting backward from the date of publication of IFT in the newspaper], (4) The minimum amount of liquid
assets or working capital or credit facilities of the Tenderer shall be Tk. 80 Crore. (5) The minimum Tender capacity shall be
Tk. 310 crore, (6) Tenderers must have up-to-date valid Licenses as applicable, (7) Other required eligibility and conditions of the
tenderer are given in Tender Documents , (8) The Tenderer must submit detail calculation sheet of Tender Capacity along with
valid appropriate supporting documents.
Brief Description of Works : Construction of Toll Plaza, 12 Nos. Ramp and its Related Works under the Project ”Construction ofElevated Expressway from
Lalkhan Bazar to Sha-Amanat Airport in Chattogram City.”
Length and Width of 12 Nos. Ramp including other necessary works:
• Total Length = 4.7 Km (approximately), Width = 4.8m, 5.5m, 6.3m, 6.8m, 7.2m & 12.3m.
• 12 Nos. Ramps Construction, Road Work, Toll Plaza, Beautification Work (Water FountainConstruction), CC TV Camera with
Accessories, Flyover Administrative Monitoring BuildingConstruction, Electrification Works etc. to Complete Construction of 12
Nos. Ramps and Toll Plaza ofElevated Expressway.
